content: Hessafe guye Dawiti Filisxeemeta xooni haarides; histtidi Geete katamanne iza yuushon diza mooththata Filisxeeme asata kusheppe woththi ekkides.
Histtiin Mo7aabe dere asay izas haarettidi giira ehides.
Hessafe guye Dawiti Efiraaxise shaafa heeran diza dereta oykkana bida wode Xoobba Kawo Hadaadi7eezere oli xoonidi Hamaate gakkanaas diza biitta oykkides.
Dawiti Hadaadi7eezereppe 1,000 para-gaareta, 7,000 toga asatanne 20,000 tohon bi olettiza wottadarata di7ides; Dawiti 100 gaaretas gidiza parata ashshidi hara parata ubbaas gaade xapho gildaydes.
Damasqo kataman diza Aaraame asati Xoobba dere Kawo Hadaadi7eezere maaddanaas yida wode Dawiti isttafe 22,000 as wodhides.
Hessafe guye Aaraame biittan Damasqo kataman olanchchati dunkaani uttanaaso giigsides; histtiin Aaraame dere asati Dawites haarettidi giirida; Dawiti bidaso ubbaan GODAY izas xoono immides.
Kawo Dawiti Hadaadi7eezere olanchchata halaqati oykkida worqqa gondalleta woththi ekkidi Yerusalaame efides.
Qasseka Dawiti Hadaadi7eezerey haariza Xibahaaneppenne Kuna katamappe keehi daro xarqimala ekkides; Solomooney he xarqimalata gita gabate, tuussatanne dumma dumma miishshata medhissides.
Dawiti Xoobba dere Kawo Hadaadi7eezere olanchchata ubbaa xoonidayssa Hamaate kawo Too7uyi siyides.

Histtidi banara olettishe gam7ida Hadaadi7eezere Dawiti oli xoonida gishshas iza hashshu gaanaassinne sarokkanaas Too7uyi ba naaza Hadoraame kawo Dawitekko kiittides; Hadoraamey worqqafe, birappenne xarqimalappe oosettida miishshata izas ekki yides.
Kawo Dawiti Eedoomeppe, Mo7aabeppe, Amoone asatappe, Filisxeemetappenne Amaaleeqe asatappe di7i ekkida biranne worqqa ha miishshatara issife gaththi GODAAS dummasides.
Xuriya naa Abisayey Eedoome asaappe 18,000 as Maxine Shoobban wodhides.
Hessafe guye Dawiti Eedoomen olanchchati dunkaani uttanaaso giigsides; histtiin he biitta asati ubbay Dawites haarettidi giiri aqida; Dawiti bidaso ubbaan GODAY izas xoono immides.
Dawiti Isra7eele deraa ubbaa bolla kawotides; deraa ubbaa xilloteththaninne suure pirdan ayssides.
Xuriya naa Iyo7aabey ola gadawa; Ahiluude naa Iyoosaafixey mazgaba keeththa alaafe.
Ahixuube naa Saadooqeynne Abiyaataare naa Abimelekkey qeese; Susahay waanna xaafe;
Yoodahe naa Bannayay Kelitetassinne Pelitetas halaqa; kawo Dawite attuma nayti iza kawoteththan dhoqqa shuumeta.
